name: poseit-promo
description: Poseit promo film (vertical 1080x1920, 30 fps), built in Remotion from the app's own pose data

scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts Promo out/promo.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.draft: remotion render src/index.ts Promo out/draft.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 22 --scale 0.5
